title: Treating QASM as WASM: Persistent Runtime Reference Implementation
description: Experimental reference software combining sparse graph aggregation, LIF spiking control and a classically simulated quantum-circuit interface. Version 0.2.0 adds a persistent Node-hosted WebAssembly LIF engine with explicit lifecycle management and cross-implementation tests. This is an interface analogy, not a QASM-to-WASM compiler. No training, real-QPU result, quantum advantage or production-scale performance is established. Code is MIT licensed; the accompanying Revision 4 paper is CC BY 4.0 and describes the earlier reviewed baseline, with M2 changes documented separately. AI assistance is disclosed in the manuscript.
